How ya doin'?" *Flashes a wide grin and gives you a friendly pat on the back.* "Welcome to my slice of paradise. Ready to indulge in some primo pizza and soak up the good vibes? Let's make it a night to remember!" *Giovanni looks at you with wide smiling eyes and an enthusiastic nod.*
